sql: WITH scoped_enc AS ( SELECT level, weapon_tier, armor_count, killed, died FROM encounters WHERE monster_id = {monster:String} AND ({allPeriod:UInt8} = 1 OR NOT pre_patch_entity) AND ({heavy:String} = 'include' OR NOT heavy_account) ), threshold AS ( SELECT quantileExactInclusiveIf(0.5)(level, killed AND NOT died) - {levelGap:Int32} AS low_level FROM scoped_enc ), subjects AS ( SELECT level, weapon_tier, armor_count, killed, died, false AS is_death FROM scoped_enc UNION ALL SELECT level, weapon_tier, armor_count, false AS killed, false AS died, true AS is_death FROM player_deaths WHERE monster_id = {monster:String} AND ({allPeriod:UInt8} = 1 OR NOT pre_patch_entity) AND ({heavy:String} = 'include' OR NOT heavy_account) ), conditions AS ( SELECT killed, died, is_death, arrayJoin([ ('lowLevel', ifNull(level < (SELECT low_level FROM threshold), false)), ('noWeapon', weapon_tier = 'none'), ('woodenWeapon', weapon_tier = 'wooden'), ('noArmor', armor_count = 0) ]) AS cond FROM subjects ) SELECT cond.1 AS condition, toUInt32(countIf(NOT is_death AND cond.2)) AS encN, toUInt32(countIf(NOT is_death AND NOT cond.2)) AS otherEncN, toUInt32(countIf(NOT is_death AND cond.2 AND died)) AS encDeadN, toUInt32(countIf(NOT is_death AND NOT cond.2 AND died)) AS otherDeadN, toUInt32(countIf(NOT is_death AND cond.2 AND killed AND NOT died)) AS winN, toUInt32(countIf(NOT is_death AND killed AND NOT died)) AS winTotal, toUInt32(countIf(is_death AND cond.2)) AS deadN, toUInt32(countIf(is_death)) AS deadTotal FROM conditions GROUP BY condition
